security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU, if the Sstc extension is implemented and menvcfg.STCE=1, but the emulation still treats mip.STIP as writable by M-mode CSR writes (instead of read-only reflecting the stimecmp comparison signal), the spec is violated
security_spec.summary: QEMU must enforce that mip.STIP becomes read-only when stimecmp is active (Sstc+STCE=1), otherwise M-mode software in QEMU emulation can forge timer interrupts to S-mode, breaking the security boundary between M-mode firmware and S-mode OS for timer interrupt delivery
